question.html:
The pressure p and volume V diagram represents a Carnot cycle for an ideal monatomic gas.

a Show, using the first law of thermodynamics, that during the process from A to B energy is supplied to the gas. [3]

b

The following data are given:

Volume of the gas at A: 2.2 × 10−3 m3
Pressure of the gas at A: 4.3 × 105 Pa
Pressure of the gas at D: 1.7 × 105 Pa

b.i Show that the volume of the gas at D is about 4 × 10−3 m3. [2]

b.ii Calculate the efficiency of this Carnot cycle. [3]
